cards.title: Replaced as Standard
items: Main bearings and connecting rod bearings
We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during every AJ30 rebuild.
Every gasket and seal is replaced as standard to ensure a factory-fresh seal.
Timing chain components are inspected and replaced where required during the rebuild process.
